verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, open-source CLI (ramp-public/ramp-cli), and a probe confirms the repo exists. It installs via Homebrew or a script and uses browser OAuth plus headless client-credential agent login. It is built for agents: `--agent` JSON output is the default when piped, `--no-input` supports CI, human and agent profiles can be switched, it covers 12 resources (bills, cards, transactions, reimbursements and more), and it includes packaged skills such as agentic-purchase. Ramp's own developer docs and llms.txt recommend it for scripted agent loops. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of real-world CLI use.
